battle.name: 天門嶺之戰
battle.brief: 698年武周平定契丹的最後一役，交戰於幽州西北、營州道上要衝天門嶺。幽州刺史王孝傑率邊軍步騎與歸附的契丹、靺鞨騎兵出塞追討叛部，在山口與契丹騎隊相持。亞述長弓所代表的復合反曲弓與車騎協同，正是這類邊疆騎射對決的技術底色。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 698年天門嶺之戰，交戰一方是武周朝廷的唐軍，另一方是契丹聯盟的部眾。唐方由武則天以女皇身份直接下詔，兵部與中書門下平章事層層擬策，前線由幽州刺史兼領邊兵的唐將統率，參戰者多為幽州、營州一帶的邊軍，以及早年歸附、被編入唐軍的契丹與靺鞨部眾，另有少量騎兵與弩手支援。契丹方面自李盡忠、孫萬榮起事之後，帳下八部首領互不統屬，各自領兵出掠；到698年，聯盟已因內訌而瓦解，多數首領各據山川、互相攻伐，參戰者為不肯歸附或降而復叛的契丹騎隊，以及與之合流的鄰近部族騎兵。雙方都不是國家對國家的正式戰爭，而是一場帝國邊軍對失控部族聯盟的鎮壓兼分化之役。
countriesEn: The Battle of Tianmen Ridge in 698 was fought between the army of the Tang state under the Wu Zhou government of Empress Wu Zetian and the tribes of the Khitan confederation. On the Tang side the empress issued the orders in person, strategy was drawn up layer by layer through the Ministry of War and the chancellors of the Secretariat and the Menxia, and the front was led by the governor of Youzhou, who also held command of the frontier garrison; the troops were mostly the border soldiers of the Youzhou and Yingzhou areas, together with Khitan and Mohe auxiliaries who had surrendered in earlier years and been incorporated into the Tang army, plus a limited body of cavalry and crossbowmen. The Khitan side, since the revolt of Li Jinzhong and Sun Wanrong, consisted of eight tribal heads who did not subordinate themselves to one another and each of whom led his own raiding columns; by 698 the confederation had already broken apart under internal strife, most of the heads holding separate strongholds in the hills and attacking one another, and the men who fought at Tianmen Ridge were the Khitan bands that refused to submit or that rebelled after surrendering, together with nomadic horsemen from neighbouring groups drawn in with them. This was not a formal war between two states but a campaign in which an imperial frontier army sought to suppress and simultaneously divide a tribal confederation that had lost control.
people: 唐方最關鍵的人物是幽州刺史王孝傑。他是高宗末年與武周初年數度出擊契丹的名將，熟稔營州、昌黎至幽州一線的山道與部族情勢，天門嶺一役的進止都與他的判斷直接相關；同年在朝中他因功高自恃、又與酷吏往來，被武則天下令處置，數月之間由平叛名將變成階下囚，邊軍為之氣沮。對面的契丹方面，這時已沒有力能號令八部的統一首領：李盡忠、孫萬榮在685年起的叛亂中被唐軍打散，孫萬榮更死於自己的部下，698年在外作戰者只是各部首領與其族屬，許多人仍在降唐與反唐之間反覆。史籍另載前箕州刺史李崇於685年冬在同一座山口被契丹擊敗，李崇與其子李諤相繼歿於亂軍，唐軍死者以萬計，天門嶺自此成為唐人視為不祥之地，也因此更為武人所忌。
peopleEn: The key Tang figure was the governor of Youzhou, Wang Xiaojie, a commander who had campaigned against the Khitan several times in the late reign of Gaozong and in the first years of the Wu Zhou, who knew the mountain roads and the tribal politics between Yingzhou, Changli and Youzhou, and whose judgement determined how the fighting at Tianmen Ridge began and ended. In the same year his position collapsed: accused of arrogance born of his achievements and of consorting with the harsh officials, he was put to death on the empress's order, and within a few months he went from celebrated pacifier to condemned prisoner, which chilled the frontier army. On the Khitan side there was by then no leader able to order the eight tribes: Li Jinzhong and Sun Wanrong had been broken by Tang troops during the revolt that began in 685, and Sun Wanrong was killed by his own followers, so the men in the field in 698 were only tribal heads and their kin, many of them still moving back and forth between submission and rebellion. The records note further that Li Chong, formerly governor of Jizhou, was defeated by the Khitan at this same pass in the winter of 685, Li Chong and his son Li E perishing one after the other amid the rout, the Tang dead being counted in thousands; from that day Tianmen Ridge was a name Tang officers avoided, and the memory only sharpened the court's mistrust of it.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是亞述長弓，即兩河流域標準的復合反曲弓，以木製弓胎、外貼牛角、筋纏為複合結構，箭長接近一公尺，拉力大而箭速高，亞述軍隊的標準用法是弓兵立於車上射擊，車兵依弓兵掩護向前突破，最後以重裝戰車碾平敵陣。把它放到698年的天門嶺，是取它所代表的技術底色：遠射加上機動車隊的組合。真正的天門嶺戰場上，唐邊軍配備的是竹木蒙角筋的步弓、臂弩與蹶張弩，輔以長槊、直刀與鳴鐗，鎧以皮甲為主而備少量明光鐵甲；契丹騎隊則用小弓，張力合手而開弓迅捷，適合高速機動中拋射，配標槍、骨朵與長柄刀，全靠馬匹的衝力與弓箭的覆蓋，不依賴攻城器械，也沒有正面攻城的需要。糧秣方面，幽州是唐軍出師的基地，營州與昌黎是前哨與目標，糧車隨軍而進；契丹以游牧方式自給，游騎在邊境內外遷徙，因此可以打了就走，令唐軍疲於追擊。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Assyrian bow, the standard composite recurve bow of Mesopotamia, built on a wooden core faced with horn and bound in sinew, its arrows close to a metre long, of powerful draw and high arrow velocity; the standard Assyrian employment was for the archers to shoot from the platform of the war chariot, the chariotry advancing under that cover until the heavy wheels crushed the enemy line. Setting it at Tianmen Ridge in 698 takes it as a sign of the technical ground on which the fight stood: the pairing of long-range shooting with mobile chariots. On the actual field the Tang frontier garrison carried bamboo-and-wood bows faced with horn and sinew, hand crossbows and traction crossbows, supported by long spears, straight swords and whistling javelins, with leather armour for the most part and a little bright plate; the Khitan horsemen used small bows of a draw that suited one hand and could be loosed fast, ideal for shooting from the gallop, together with javelins, maces and long-handled blades, relying on the momentum of the horse and the cover of arrows rather than on siege engines, and having no need to conduct a formal siege. As to supply, Youzhou was the base from which the Tang army marched out, while Yingzhou and Changli served as forward posts and objectives, the baggage trains moving with the column; the Khitan lived off the land as herders, their riders moving across the border steppe, which meant they could fight and run away, wearing down Tang pursuit.
tactics: 天門嶺是燕山東段的一處山口，夾在營州—昌黎—幽州的邊軍驛路上，兩側陡坡夾道，谷底寬度不足以展開大隊騎兵，攻守全看誰能控制山口兩端。契丹騎手的戰法是先以遊騎遮斷道路、誘使唐軍深入，再退入山坳放棄通道，等唐軍前隊拉開而器械車隊尚未上來時，從兩翼坡上以馬弓與標槍覆蓋谷底，隨即以密集騎兵衝下山坡，衝散唐軍陣形；唐代邊軍慣用的對應是結陣而進，前列以大盾與長槊結成拒馬，弩手居後待發，弓手分列兩翼仰射坡上，待敵騎衝至數十步內再以長槊與陌刀迎擊，並利用山口寬度限制敵騎展開，待其銳氣耗盡再以騎兵由側翼反擊。輸贏的關鍵常在風與塵：燕山山口多西北風，乾季起風時揚塵蔽日，前後隊的視線與號令都會失靈。史料記載，685年李崇部在同一山口正是遇大風迷目而全軍潰散，此後各次交戰雙方都把風候與進退節奏視為生死之事。唐軍在此次進攻中仍以招撫為先、討伐為輔，企圖用封路斷糧、逼近據點的辦法逼出契丹首領，而不是在野外交鋒中消耗自己。
tacticsEn: Tianmen Ridge was a gap in the eastern Yan Mountains sitting on the frontier post road that ran Yingzhou, Changli and Youzhou, steep slopes pressing in on either side and a valley floor too narrow to deploy a great body of cavalry, so that everything turned on who held the two ends of the gap. The Khitan method was to send out free riders to cut the road and draw the Tang deep, then fall back into the hollows and give up the pass, waiting until the Tang vanguard had been stretched and the baggage had not yet come up before covering the valley floor from the slopes with horse bows and javelins, and then charging down in dense columns to break the Tang order. The standard Tang answer was to advance in formation, the front rank locking shields and long spears into a fence, crossbowmen waiting behind, archers posted on the flanks to shoot up at the slopes, and only when the enemy cavalry came within a few tens of paces meeting them with spear and dao, using the narrowness of the pass to stop the riders deploying and then striking their flank once their momentum had been spent. Wind and dust often decided the issue: the Yan Mountain gaps are open to the north-west wind, and in the dry season a rising wind carries dust that darkens the sky, breaking both the sight lines and the chain of command between units. The records show that in 685 it was precisely a gale that blinded Li Chong's men at this same pass and brought the whole army down, and after that both sides in later fights watched the wind and the timing of advance and withdrawal as matters of life and death. In this campaign the Tang still put conciliation first and coercion second, hoping by blocked roads and cut supply, and by pressing on the strongpoints, to force the Khitan chiefs into the open rather than exhausting themselves in a pitched fight in the open country.
data: 關於本役的原始數字保存下來的很少，只能給出量級。〈資治通鑑〉與〈舊唐書〉記698年前後唐與契丹的交鋒，多以「契丹內亂」「出兵討之」數語帶過，未給出征發兵力的確數；一般認為唐方出動的兵馬在萬餘至數萬之間，其中主力為幽州邊軍步卒，騎兵比例偏低，契丹參戰者為八部中數個不肯歸附的部眾，合計亦在數萬量級，而雙方在山口狹窄地形上同時能夠展開的不過數千人。時間上，交戰集中於698年六月前後的數日，同年九月武則天改元聖曆，說明朝廷正把此役當作一場需要新朝氣象來收尾的戰事。傷亡方面，記錄最清楚的是685年天門嶺前一次交鋒，李崇部大敗之後，追擊途中被殲者與散失者以萬計，器械與資糧盡為敵所取，幽州一線的邊軍為此重新補充兵員與馬匹達一年之久。距離上，營州（今遼寧朝陽）到天門嶺約數百華里，昌黎在二者之間，幽州（今北京）再往西北一日路程，天門嶺正卡在這條補給線的喉嚨上。至於686年之後各次「破契丹」的斬獲數與俘虜數，諸史記載互有出入，本文只取可互相印證的部分，其餘付之闕疑。
dataEn: Few original figures for this action survive, so only orders of magnitude can be given. The Zizhi Tongjian and the Old Book of Tang record the fighting between the Tang and the Khitan around 698 mostly in a few phrases such as 'the Khitan fell into internal strife' and 'an army was sent out to punish them', without giving an exact strength figure. It is generally held that the Tang force numbered in the tens of thousands at most, the bulk being foot soldiers of the Youzhou frontier garrison with a low proportion of cavalry, while the Khitan participants were several of the eight tribes that refused to submit, likewise in the tens of thousands in all, of which only a few thousand could be brought into the line at once on ground this narrow. In time the action occupied a few days around June 698; the empress changed the era name to Shengli in September of the same year, which shows how the court regarded this as a concluding battle that needed a new dynastic air about it. On losses the clearest record belongs to the earlier clash at Tianmen Ridge in 685, when after Li Chong's defeat the men killed in the pursuit and those scattered without their arms were counted in thousands, arms and supply were taken by the enemy, and the frontier force on the Youzhou line had to be rebuilt with fresh men and horses for the better part of a year. As to distance, from Yingzhou, now Chaoyang in Liaoning, to Tianmen Ridge is several hundred li, with Changli lying between them and Youzhou, now Beijing, another day's march to the north-west; Tianmen Ridge sat exactly at the throat of that supply line. The numbers of killed and captured in the various records of 'breaking the Khitan' after 686 differ from text to text, so only the portions that corroborate one another have been used here and the rest left as open questions.
cause: 698年天門嶺的交火，根源在契丹聯盟本身的瓦解。契丹自唐初起以八部聯盟的形式臣屬於唐，名義上的首領不過是唐廷冊封的松漠都督一類名號，實權分散在各自為政的部族首領手上。685年李盡忠、孫萬榮舉兵反唐，一度攻陷營州，殺死都督趙文㞝，把幽州、昌黎一線的邊防撕開一個口子；唐軍兩度出塞，終於在686年前後打散這股勢力，但契丹並未因此統一，反而因主要首領接連死亡而分裂得更厲害，各部首領互相攻伐、爭奪牧地與部眾，連降唐的部眾也因安置、編制與分配不周而屢有叛變。到698年，朝廷判斷邊患已不是能不能討平、而是能不能讓契丹從此不再凝聚，於是改變單純武力進剿的做法，把出兵、冊封與招撫三者合一：封爵以分化各部，收撫以拆散其聯盟，出兵則專取不肯歸附、仍在侵擾邊地的武裝。唐軍選擇在天門嶺一線發動，正是因為這裡是營州方向上唯一能由山口正面攔截的關口。
causeEn: The clash at Tianmen Ridge in 698 had its root in the disintegration of the Khitan confederation itself. Since the early Tang the Khitan had existed as a league of eight tribes in vassalage to Tang; the nominal leader was nothing more than a title conferred by the Tang court, such as Governor of Songmo, while real authority was divided among chiefs who each commanded their own people. In 685 Li Jinzhong and Sun Wanrong rose in revolt, briefly took Yingzhou, killed the commander Zhao Wen'e and tore a hole in the frontier defence along the Youzhou and Changli line; Tang armies marched out twice and eventually broke that force around 686, but the Khitan were not thereby united, and with their principal chiefs dying one after another they split apart further, each head raiding his neighbours and contending for pasture and followers, while even those who had surrendered to Tang repeatedly rebelled because their settlement, enrolment and distribution were badly managed. By 698 the court judged that the frontier danger was no longer a matter of whether the Khitan could be beaten but of whether they could be prevented from ever coalescing again, so it changed from simple armed pursuit to a combination of military action, enfeoffment and conciliation: titles to divide the tribes, amnesty to dissolve the league, and force directed only at the armed bands that would not submit and still harried the border. The Tang chose to strike along the Tianmen Ridge line because it was the one point on the road to Yingzhou where a column coming from the north could be met frontally at a gap in the mountains.
impact: 天門嶺一役的短期結果，是唐軍控制了山口，把契丹殘部擋在谷地之外，698年之後數年，東北邊境沒有再出現685年那樣成建制的營州淪陷。更深遠的影響落在契丹一邊：八部內訌在唐廷的干預下加速，鬆散的聯盟被壓成更小、彼此更加防備的單位，這份碎片化的版圖一直延續到九世紀初葉，耶律部才在其中崛起，阿保機廢諸部而立可汗之號，開啟遼的建國；唐廷的羈縻冊封手法也在同時定型，契丹的松漠都督府與同年靺鞨首領所受封號構成了北方羈縻體系的骨架，此後數百年間屢為中原王朝所用，成為分化北方的固定工具。對唐的邊軍體系而言，此役同時暴露兩個問題：一是山地騎射戰中弓弩的覆蓋面不足，器械車隊在狹窄通道裡反而成為拖累；二是立功的將領無法得到朝廷信任，王孝傑的下場尤其說明武周後期對邊將的猜忌有多深，今後的邊防只能倚賴契丹降將與胡漢混編的軍隊，而這支軍隊的忠誠從一開始就是問題。
impactEn: In the short term the battle of Tianmen Ridge left the Tang in control of the gap, the Khitan remnants held out of the valley, and for the several years after 698 the north-eastern frontier saw no fall of Yingzhou on the scale of 685. The deeper effect fell on the Khitan side: internal strife accelerated under Tang intervention, the loose league was compressed into smaller units that distrusted one another even more, and this fragmented map lasted until the early ninth century, when the Yelu tribe rose within it and Abaoji set aside the several tribal heads to establish the title of khagan, opening the way to the founding of the Liao; at the same time the Tang method of enfeoffment hardened, the Songmo commandery of the Khitan and the title granted in the same year to the leader of the Mohe forming the frame of a northern system of commanderies and protectorates, a tool used repeatedly by the Central Plain dynasties for the next several hundred years and becoming a fixed instrument for dividing the north. On the Tang side the same campaign exposed two problems: in mountain fighting against mounted archers the coverage of bows and crossbows was insufficient, and the baggage trains became a hindrance in narrow defiles; and a commander who had won a war of conquest could not be trusted by his court, as the fate of Wang Xiaojie shows how deep the mistrust of frontier commanders ran in late Wu Zhou, so from then on the frontier had to rest on surrendered Khitan generals and mixed Hu and Han units whose loyalty was doubtful from the outset.
result: 698年的天門嶺之役以唐軍控制山口告一段落。唐軍沒有能一舉殲滅契丹聯盟，也沒有奪回全部失地，但契丹殘部被逐回松漠方向，營州至幽州的驛道重新可通，昌黎、營州一線的前哨得以恢復巡邏，編入唐軍的契丹、靺鞨降眾則被安置在幽州一帶，充作邊軍與屯田的補充。戰役的代價卻不輕：唐軍在山口折損了相當數量的步卒與馬匹，最精銳的邊軍騎手大部耗於追擊；主將王孝傑雖以此役再立功名，卻在同年因與朝中酷吏往來、恃功怨望，被武則天下令處置，死於非命，成為武周邊軍將領的下場。從長遠看，這一役真正解決的不是契丹，而是問題的處理方式：武周放棄了一次性消滅，改為以冊封、編制、駐防三位一體，把北方游牧勢力固定在羈縻體系之內。這套辦法在此後數十年內屢屢奏效，也埋下新的隱患——受封的部族首領在唐廷的縱容下逐漸坐大，終有一天會發現，羈縻之網一旦收緊，被困在網中的不只唐廷一方。
resultEn: The battle of 698 ended with the Tang holding the gap. The Tang army neither wiped out the Khitan league nor recovered all the lost ground, but the Khitan remnants were driven back towards the Songmo direction, the post road from Yingzhou to Youzhou was usable again, the forward posts on the Changli and Yingzhou line could resume their patrols, and the surrendered Khitan and Mohe were settled around Youzhou to fill out the frontier garrison and the farming garrisons. The cost was not light: the Tang lost a considerable number of foot soldiers and horses in the pass, and most of the best frontier horsemen were spent in the pursuit; the commander Wang Xiaojie, though credited with new laurels, was in the same year put to death on the empress's order, accused of consorting with the harsh officials at court and of resenting his achievements, dying an unjust death that fixed the pattern for Wu Zhou frontier commanders. In the longer run what this campaign truly settled was not the Khitan but the way the problem was handled: the Wu Zhou gave up the idea of a single decisive destruction and adopted enfeoffment, enrolment and garrisoning together, fixing the northern nomadic powers inside a system of commanderies and protectorates. That method worked repeatedly in the decades that followed, and it also planted a new danger: the enfeoffed tribal heads grew strong under Tang patronage, and one day it would become clear that when the net of commandery rule tightened, the party caught in it would not be the Tang court alone.
